# Vendored libraries

Served by the table itself, so it works without an internet connection. Unmodified copies of:

| File | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `marked.min.js` | [marked](https://github.com/markedjs/marked) | 12.0.2 | MIT |
| `purify.min.js` | [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) | 3.1.6 | Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0 |
| `leaflet/` (js, css, images) | [Leaflet](https://leafletjs.com) | 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause |

To update one, download the same files of the new version from cdnjs or jsDelivr into the same paths.
